notes.title: Meet the new Screen Recorder 2023!
notes.content:
[b]We are constantly improving and adding new features to the program. [/b]

[b]The main updates are:[/b]

[list]
[*][b] Scrolling screenshots[/b]

No need to take endless screenshots anymore. Take scrolling screenshots to capture content that doesn't fit on the screen.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1497120/extras/Scrolling_screenshots.png?t=1681745780[/img]

[*] [b]Drawing shapes on video[/b]

Convey your ideas more clearly now — add arrows, squares, or circles to highlight certain parts of your video.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1497120/extras/Drawing_shapes_on_video.png?t=1681745780[/img]

[*] [b]Plus some other minor bug fixes and improvements.[/b]
[/list]

tags.bug: Plus some other minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Screen Recorder update 22.4 is here!
notes.content:
[b]Here are the new features now available in Movavi Screen Recorder 22.4:
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Set the time limit before or during recording. [/b]
Press the timer button, set the time, and select the action after the recording ends. Simple and convenient!
[img]https://new-img.movavi.com/products/0013/41/4cb90fd428bb57185fa80b61dbb31b45f5e4ab28.png[/img]
[*] [b]The size of your recordings is now smaller, and the quality is better.
 [/b]
[*] [b]Plus some other minor bug fixes and improvements. [/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Screen Recorder update 22.2 is here!
notes.content:
[b]Here are the new features now available in Movavi Screen Recorder 22.2:
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Noise reduction[/b]
No need to worry about loud neighbors or colleagues any longer! Our new noise reduction feature will help you get rid of extraneous sounds.

[*] [b]Audio control during capture[/b]
Forgot to turn the system sound on or disable the mic? Set your sound up during capture using the familiar buttons on the control panel.

[b][*] Minor improvements and bug fixes[/b][/list]

notes.title: Great news – we’ve released Movavi Screen Recorder 22!
notes.content:
[b]Here is what you’ll find in the upgraded Movavi Screen Recorder 22:[/b]
[list]
[*] Windows 11 support
[*] Screen recording for the widescreen monitors: no more cropped and compressed images
[*] Correct hotkey settings: your computer won’t freeze anymore
[*] Smooth audio play in the preview window. We’ve fixed audio break off, so you can now play it without problems
[/list]
